seated:
Create ONE square full-body FRONT seated reference of the SAME BABY DAEKIMI from image1. Image2 is supplementary BABY torso/head volume reference. Image3 is ONLY for the naturally TIED TAIL RIBBON: do not take adult body, adult skin, straight ears/antennae or smile from it.
POSE / EXPRESSION: head upright, zero head tilt, straight-on neutral front gaze. Keep original unique rounded triangular black eye contours and eye-to-face proportions, broad rounded baby cat face and chin, NOT a newly circular generic face. Correct positional asymmetry caused by head tilt so eye baselines are level, nose and tiny closed cat mouth centered. Expression RELAXED NEUTRAL: no pout, frown, downturned sadness, pleading gaze, smile, tongue or blush. Original eye designs EACH one large bright white FOUR-point star, one smaller muted-gray sparkle, one tiny pale diamond. Do not make every sparkle white.
BODY CORRECTION: preserve original tiny chubby baby torso and enormous head relationship, not adult. Seat upright on bottom, both short rounded feet forward, soles visible. Both short arms gently lowered at the body's sides, tiny mitten paws resting beside upper thighs, no separated digits. Upper chest/shoulders should be softly full and broad enough to support the head naturally, tucked closely underneath jaw with NO visible neck or pinched narrow bottleneck. Do not create a pear-shaped torso or oversized spread-out hips: seated lower body and foot spacing must remain compact like image1; body upper/lower volume balanced, no widened base. Preserve small feet/source pad scale. Each sole pink one main pad+FOUR small ovals. Palms may be hidden naturally.
IDENTITY: original sky blue, tiny uniform dense plush down, no visible long strands, directional swirls or coarse clumps, same soft collectible plush 3D render. Character LEFT cat ear folded (viewer-right), RIGHT triangular ear upright. LEFT antenna bends softly outward (viewer-right) while RIGHT rises, each stem/ball SMOOTH hairless, exactly2 round balls. These asymmetries are anatomy, not a tilted head. Tail small plump blue cat curl at rear, viewer-right. No changes to face identity.
RIBBON: Remove ALL draped ribbon from head/ears/shoulders/chest/hands/floor. ONE delicate pink cloth ribbon physically wraps around tail near outer curved segment before curl tip. Clearly visible wrap band conforms to tail and feeds into ONE cinched central knot. Exactly TWO volumetric folded cloth loops with hollow inner space, soft creases and subtly different orientations/shape, one may recede naturally; exactly TWO separate tails drape downward under gravity. Match image3's irregular soft loop shape, fabric folds and natural tied attachment. NOT a flat symmetrical clip-on bow badge stuck facing camera, not rigid butterfly, not two bows, no forced front/back pairing. Partial overlap from actual 3D knot and tail, clear contact shadow. Modest size relative baby tail. Tail ends softly curl; ribbon tails stay beside tail, no floor train.
Same warm ivory seamless backdrop and diffused soft studio light as image1, full silhouette with comfortable margins, no labels/text/grid/props. ONE original baby seated neutral pose.
standing: Create the STANDING FRONT counterpart to the seated neutral baby sample. Preserve same original BABY Daekimi head silhouette, neutral straight gaze, leveled head, unique eye contours and all three eye motifs per eye, sky-blue short uniform plush down, folded left ear, bent left antenna and both SMOOTH round antenna balls, no blush and tiny relaxed closed cat mouth. Change only lower pose: tiny chubby body and very short legs standing with both feet flat, both short arms naturally lowered. Full soft shoulder/chest supporting head naturally with hidden neck, no pinched neck or enlarged pear belly. Same head/torso scale, same compact hands/feet without digit grooves. Sole/palm pink pads each one main plus FOUR small remain on undersides and are naturally hidden in front arms-down standing; no pads on tops/backs. One blue curled cat tail, one naturally tied pink cloth bow on tail ONLY. Continuous wrap around tail enters one cinched knot, two softly folded hollow loops with subtle natural asymmetry and creases, two downward ends, three-dimensional overlap/occlusion from physical attachment, not flat clip-on badge. No ribbon on head/ears/hands/body/floor. Preserve modest tail/bow size. Original baby plush render, warm ivory backdrop, soft diffused light, square full-body framing, same baby identity as neutral seated counterpart. No labels, extras or accessories. Use original BABY images for identity, adult reference only for fabric knot and wrapping.
